analysis: Price has pushed above VAH at 73,500, but the move is predominantly driven by derivatives leverage as perp CVD delta outpaces spot by nearly 2:1. Lack of leading spot aggression leaves this breakout vulnerable to leverage exhaustion and a sharp pull-back into the value area.
key_risk: Acceptance back below VAH at 73,500 triggering a long liquidation cascade down to POC at 73,350.
